a.label: A
a.name: A · Forest hero on every look
a.line: The meal card is solid forest in all four looks; the header carries the mood as a hue (apricot Siang, sage Malam) in light, and as charcoal or deep forest in dark.

refs.note: forest, sunrise, cream and charcoal

b.label: B
b.name: B · Day and night swap
b.line: Siang puts a forest meal card under a light apricot header; Malam turns it over: a forest header over a light meal card. The page sits one tone down so white cards and the tab bar stand off it.

refs.note: forest, sunrise, cream and charcoal

c.label: C
c.name: C · Light card with a drawn edge
c.line: Closest to today: the meal card stays light in light and charcoal in dark, and a 1.5dp edge in the mood's own ink draws it. The headers deepen (apricot Siang, brand forest Malam) and the brown goes.

refs.note: forest, sunrise, cream and charcoal

d.label: D
d.name: D · One green, two depths
d.line: One leaf green does the brand's work: the Siang header, the button and the selected tab. Malam is the same green at night depth (today's forest, kept). The meal card is always a plain white card with a drawn edge on a rice-white page, so it never melts into the header. Sunrise steps back to a warning colour.
d.idea: Brand in one hue at two depths; neutral room; white meal card.

refs.note: green header, warm off-white page, white cards
house green deep, accent green for actions
one deep brand hue for every action
neutral dark, brand only where selected

e.label: E
e.name: E · Sambal on a white table
e.line: A warm chili orange becomes the only brand colour and green leaves the interface (it stays in the art). Siang wears a solid sambal header, Malam a deep kopi brown with peach markers. The page is a white table, cards a warm step down with a drawn edge, and the meal card is white. Every action is the same chili with a white label.
e.idea: Warm single brand on a white room, the way SEA delivery apps spend one loud colour.

refs.note: white room, brand only in pills, tab and badges
solid brand header over a white list
one red for every primary action, white label
orange brand, action pill in the brand

f.label: F
f.name: F · Deep teal, tonal cards
f.line: A new deep teal replaces forest, and the meal card wears it in every look, with a white button on it. Siang has a light mint header, Malam a deep ink one. Cards are one tonal step below the page with no border, as Material 3 does, and marigold is the one warm accent (today ring, Gagal diantar).
f.idea: A calm new hue that is not the old forest, carried by tone rather than lines.

refs.note: deep teal actions, tonal cards with no border
deep green-teal for selection, tonal greige cards
bright teal for icons, a darker teal ink for text
status card in the brand with a white pill on it

g.label: G
g.name: G · Linen, olive and forest
g.line: Your reference palette, revised: linen, olive and forest do the work. A linen page with lighter linen cards, tab bar and meal card (the meal card edged in olive); an olive Siang header and a forest Malam header, the same two greens at night depth in dark mode; a forest button and forest markers. Beige and taupe are only hairlines. Pale copper is the reddish accent in three places: the active tracker stop, prices and the Gagal diantar stop.
g.idea: The owner's palette led by linen, olive and forest, with a copper accent.

refs.note: five colours supplied on 2026-10-13, plus Pale Copper
main colours linen, olive and forest; much less beige and taupe; Pale Copper as a reddish accent in a few places

h.label: H
h.name: H · Today's palette, neutral-led
h.line: Today's hues with neutrals still doing most of the work, turned up a notch. Siang has a soft apricot header and Malam a soft sage one (a warm brown and a green in dark). The meal card is a tinted card (cream by day, pale sage at night) with an edge in the mood's deep ink. Forest marks the button, the active tab, the selected pill and the today ring; sunrise ink is the highlight on the active tracker stop and on prices.

j.label: J
j.name: J · C, with a green ground and brown highlights
j.line: Terang Siang and Terang Malam are C unchanged. In dark mode the page is not charcoal: it is C's Malam forest, one step deeper, with cards, tab bar and the meal card in lighter steps of the same green. Card edges, markers and the selected tab follow the mood's brown.
j.idea: C by day; a forest room with brown highlights after dark.

k.label: K
k.name: K · Today's palette, used with restraint
k.line: Today's forest, sunrise, cream and charcoal, spent the way top food apps spend a brand colour. Page, header and tab bar are cream and neutrals (charcoal in dark); the meal card is a plain card that stands off the header by a fine edge, so the food photo carries the warmth. Forest fills only the primary button and marks the active tab, the selected segment and today's date. The tracker is ink; sunrise marks only the current stop. Prices are bold ink, and Gagal diantar keeps its own red with its words. Siang and Malam are a faint header tint and the sun/moon mark, nothing more.
k.idea: Today's hues on neutral ground: one forest button, small forest marks, one branded moment.
